{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Quote|It's the greatest speeder-bike course anyone ever imagined, Jarael! Everybody big has ridden here! Major Tarrance, the D'qell Sisters, Goethar Kleej&mdash;|Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KOTOR39">[[Knights of the Old Republic 39|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 39]]</ref>}}
[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Tarrance''' was a famous duelist who, at some point, participated in [[Swoopdueling/Legends|swoopdueling]] on the network of arenas known as [[Jervo's World]] above<ref name="KOTOR39" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FactFile">{{FactFile|124|PAN 1-2|Pantolomin}}</ref> [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]].<ref name="KOTOR39" /> Around [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="KOTOR39Date">[[Knights of the Old Republic 39|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 39]] states that the story occurs approximately 3963 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and his companion [[Jarael]] visited Jervo's World. While in the [[Hall of Champions]], Carrick excitedly exclaimed that it was the greatest [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] course ever imagined and that famous individuals had ridden it, including Tarrance, the [[D'qell Sisters]], and [[Goethar Kleej]].<ref name="KOTOR39" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarrance was mentioned in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 39|thirty ninth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="KOTOR39" /> on [[March 18]], [[2009]].<ref name="KOTOR39Release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54358/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_39|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #39}}</ref>
